name: drag and drop  1 to 1
description: A replacement for this question type- although it may focus more on clicking than dragging

hint.value: "Select a tile or a space, then select a match to move the tile to the space. You can use tab and space bar."

marking_script:
mark:
if(interpreted_answer = 0, incorrect("You have not found any matches. Try again?"),
if(interpreted_answer < input_options["how_many_gaps"],if (input_options['all_or_nothing'],incorrect("You must find all matches to get the marks") , apply(partialFeedback)),correct("Well done you matched them all."));end())

interpreted_answer:
studentAnswer

markPerGap:
1/input_options["how_many_gaps"]

partialFeedback:
set_credit((interpreted_answer/input_options['how_many_gaps']) , "You found some but not all of the pairs"); end()

marking_notes.name: mark
marking_notes.description: This is the main marking note. It should award credit and provide feedback based on the student's answer.
marking_notes.definition:
if(interpreted_answer = 0, incorrect("You have not found any matches. Try again?"),
if(interpreted_answer < input_options["how_many_gaps"],if (input_options['all_or_nothing'],incorrect("You must find all matches to get the marks") , apply(partialFeedback)),correct("Well done you matched them all."));end())

marking_notes.name: interpreted_answer
marking_notes.description: A value representing the student's answer to this part.

marking_notes.name: partialFeedback
marking_notes.definition: set_credit((interpreted_answer/input_options['how_many_gaps']) , "You found some but not all of the pairs"); end()

settings.name: target_text
settings.label: Paragraph(s)/image with fill in words
settings.hint:
Create gaps/drop zones using %[drop text]%. Any text within the %[ ]% will be turned into a drop item.

For capitalisation on drop put a !^! within the drop text e.g. %[!^!capitlaise anything dropped here%]

Use css styles and/or tables for layout e.g. for tables in the target_text. E.g. to change text alignment within a td use style=\"text-align:left !important\"

Insert images using the insert image tool- that will bring the alt text with it

Latex- to prevent the latex being selectable, wrap it in a span class=\"latex\" tag e.g. %[<span class=\"latex\">$(x + 4) ^ 6$</span>]%
settings.default_value: <p>Write some <strong>text</strong> with the %[targets]% marked up using %[your item here]%. </p>",

settings.name: how_many_gaps
settings.label: How many gaps are there in the question
settings.hint: Unfortunately, this cannot be determined programmtically, so you must count the gaps

settings.name: distractors
settings.label: Additional distractors
settings.hint: These are additional distractors which can be added. These drags have no 'match'. It is harder to use html here unfortunately.

settings.name: target_width
settings.label: Width of the items to be placed
settings.hint: This sets the width of both the target and of the 'draggable' items

settings.name: target_height
settings.label: Height of items to be placed
settings.hint: This sets the height of both the target and of the 'draggable' items

settings.name: mark_on_match
settings.label: Mark each answer when it is dropped
settings.hint: Default value false but if this is true the tick cross will be displayed as the items are dropped

settings.name: all_or_nothing
settings.label: Award credit only if all correct
